notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{W}{B/R}{B/R}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
